name: Kashiwabara Nanako
source:
Age: late 30s

Asuna’s biological mother. A nurse who works at a hospice (palliative care unit).

Perhaps because she works closer to death than most nurses and often accompanies patients in their final moments, she considers it her mission to listen to patients’ dying wishes; for better or worse, she is overly accommodating.
She is the greatest source of understanding for Yukito and Asuna, as well as an ideal mother who loves them dearly.
